name: Margin Collateral 1
definition: Provides details about the collateral held, in transit or that still needs to be agreed by both parties.

HeldByPartyA.name: Held By Party A
HeldByPartyA.definition: Post haircut market value of all margin collateral held by party A.

HeldByPartyB.name: Held By Party B
HeldByPartyB.definition: Post haircut market value of all margin collateral held by party B.

PriorAgreedToPartyA.name: Prior Agreed To Party A
PriorAgreedToPartyA.definition: Sum of all margin agreed amounts due to party A from prior days’ collateral calls where collateral movements have not yet been agreed.

PriorAgreedToPartyB.name: Prior Agreed To Party B
PriorAgreedToPartyB.definition: Sum of all margin agreed amounts due to party B from prior days’ collateral calls where collateral movements have not yet been agreed.

InTransitToPartyA.name: In Transit To Party A
InTransitToPartyA.definition: Sum of all margin collateral movements due to party A in progress but not yet settled.

InTransitToPartyB.name: In Transit To Party B
InTransitToPartyB.definition: Sum of all margin collateral movements due to party B in progress but not yet settled.
